game_title: Return Or Print – Lantern Square Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Lantern Square, a lantern-lit square: the snow ranger must handle ice wolves while practicing functions. Core idea – Return Or Print: Decide whether to return or print and see why only return passes data on.
theme: Snowy Hold – Lantern Square: a lantern-lit square
core_gameplay_loop: In Lantern Square, repeat each round: Decide whether to return or print and see why only return passes data on. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the court_score value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the sleigh using at most 14 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 14 before the sleigh is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 8 (extended tier): Return Or Print
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how court_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ice wolves in Lantern Square.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The sleigh reached with actions_used <= 14.
